stemMd: Which combination of SI base units is equivalent to a newton?
explanationMd: Newton's second law is force=mass times acceleration. Combining kilograms with metres per second squared gives kg m/s squared, the newton.

distractorRationale.b: This is not mass times acceleration.
distractorRationale.d: This is the unit of energy.
distractorRationale.a: This omits length and a time factor.
